Question (as in the review teams templat: Is the review based on a focused question that is adequately formulated and described?
Were eligibility criteria for included and excluded studies predefined and specified?
Did the literature search strategy use a comprehensive, systematic approach?
Were titles, abstracts, and full-text articles dually and independently reviewed for inclusion and exclusion to minimise bias?
Was the quality of each included study rated independently by two or more reviewers using a standard method to appraise its internal validity?
Were the included studies listed along with essential characteristics and results of each study?
Was heterogeneity assessed? (This question applies only to meta-analyses.)
Were the primary data collected and stored?
How consistent is the information obtained from one source with information available from other sources?
